reviews.text: I am absolutely thrilled with the installation of my new Trex fencing. The team was professional,  efficient and paid great attention to detail  throughout the entire process.  Their expertise and dedication ensured a flawless and durable fence that enhances the beauty of my property.   Thank you for a job very well done.  I highly recommend Kodiak Fence Company to anyone looking for top-notch fencing solutions.
reviews.author: Daniell Sawyer

reviews.text:
Very efficient, professional, and with a  reasonable price!

Needed to replace an old fence gate that’s misaligned and difficult to open/close.

Kodiak fence company was able to give me a reasonable estimate over the email and was efficient setting up an appointment. The new gate looks great and was stained to match the existing fence color to meet the HOA requirement. See old and new gate pictures.

When the old spring for auto-closing snapped off, they were able to sent someone out the same day and fixed it with a new spring.

Highly recommended!
reviews.author: J. Z.

reviews.text: Great company to work with! Alberto was terrific and wanted us to be completely satisfied with the installation of our rod iron fence. Leo did a wonderful job installing the fence. I highly recommend Kodiak fence!

reviews.text: Selecting the Kodiak Team to install a cedar board-on-board fence was one of the Best experiences we ever had with a contractor.  Alberto is very knowledgeable, listens to the customers needs and offers suggestions to do the job right.  Excellent communication and timely turnaround from obtaining an estimate and scheduling with Tiana, to a follow-up visit from Alberto to ensure we were completely satisfied with the fence.  Quality product installed and excellent workmanship completed by the Installers at an Affordable price.  TYVM Kodiak Team!
reviews.author: Cynthia Schlueter

reviews.text:
Highly recommend Kodiak Fence Company and their outstanding owner Alberto! From start to finish, the experience was seamless and stress-free. Our existing fence fell after harsh weather and they built an 8-foot fence for us. The quality of the craftsmanship is truly impressive. The fence looks incredible, sturdy, and was completed at a very competitive price.

Alberto was extremely accommodating and made sure to answer all our questions. He even managed to schedule the project and have everything completed within a week, which far exceeded our expectations. It’s rare to find a company that combines top-notch quality with prompt, friendly service.

If you’re looking for a reliable, skilled, and customer-focused fencing company, Kodiak Fence Company is the one to call. Alberto and his team went above and beyond, and we couldn’t recommend them more highly! Thank you, Kodiak Fence Company, for a fantastic job!
reviews.author: asif sheik

reviews.text:
I had a concrete privacy wall fall over and needed to build a fence across the section that fell.

I'm old. I tried digging the holes with an auger rental but kept having problem after problem. We gave up. Looking online we called around to a few places to see if somebody could do the holes for us. It was difficult finding anybody that was available and reasonably priced.

Kodiak told us it’s not normally something they do but would help us out. The guy just left and we couldn’t be more thrilled!

We really appreciate how Kodiak helped us with something likely no big deal to them but very substantial to us!!
reviews.author: Todd Jacobs

reviews.text: Alberto and his team at Kodiak were efficient, responsive, and highly professional throughout the entire process. Alberto promptly provided multiple bids and demonstrated flexibility in scheduling. The completed work was exactly as described—high-quality and executed with care. I highly recommend Kodiak for anyone in need of fencing services.
reviews.author: Jordan Hall
